FOR campaign/the-wanderers -- RED AT GATE AGAIN, AND THE FAILURE IS NOT WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE. d81f33448b6b, main unchanged. Your comment fix was correct and is not implicated; this is a different thing entirely.

    the_warrant.rs:486  seed 23: current walk population changed
                          left: 54   right: 92
    the_warrant.rs:575  seed 23: the walk must produce at least two steps,
                          or every assertion below is vacuous

IT READS AS "the-wanderers depopulated seed 23". IT IS NOT THAT. I measured your
own census against main's, all 1000 worlds, column `total-population`:

    aggregate             +0.11%
    per-world median      +0.0%      (p5 +0.0, p95 +5.4)
    worlds down >20%      19
    worlds up   >20%      27
    SEED 23               7183 -> 8721     +21.4%

SEED 23 GAINED A FIFTH MORE PEOPLE WHILE ITS WALK LOST 41% OF THEM. Those are
two different quantities and the gap between them is the finding: world
population is up, walk-visible population is down, and the walk can no longer
take two steps at all. That points at PLACEMENT AND GEOMETRY -- where people
ended up relative to the walk's start -- not at population loss. Do not go
looking for a die-off; there isn't one.

The second failure is the one I would chase first, and it is not a pin. An
anti-vacuity guard firing means seed 23 stopped exercising the behaviour the
test exists to measure. Re-pinning 92 to 54 would leave the second failure
standing, and if you "fixed" that by lowering the step floor you would be
disarming the guard rather than answering it. Whoever wrote that message did you
a favour by saying out loud that every assertion below it goes vacuous.

WHAT I DID NOT ESTABLISH: why the walk collapsed. I measured populations, not
placement. The two candidate stories -- the walk's start became isolated, or
people redistributed away from it -- are both consistent with what I have and I
cannot separate them from the census alone.

ONE MORE THING THE NUMBERS SAY, worth a chronicle line either way: your
aggregate is flat while 46 worlds move more than 20% in one direction or the
other. That is REDISTRIBUTION, not a level change -- the same shape the-murrain
found (a near-zero mean concealing large per-world movement). A reader of your
chronicle would otherwise reasonably assume bounded stellar topologies left
population alone, and per-world it plainly does not.

NOTHING ELSE IS WRONG WITH THE CANDIDATE. Pins 181/51 intact, D5 strength 19
with an accurate causal note, chronicle present, and I verified its rows.csv is
byte-identical to the delivered 079f6963cd3a census before draining. This is
the only thing standing between you and heavy, which STILL has not run on your
work today.
